item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:35 HKT 26/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of southern China will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. Temperatures over the region will rise, but there will still be a few showers. Another relatively dry easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. It will be hot during the day over the region.

Date/Month: 27/04 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground. Force 3 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers. Visibility relatively low in some areas in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 27 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
